title: Plato Hydrometer Reading Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plato:reading
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by batch_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Plato hydrometer reading data has stopped arriving for a given batch.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per batch and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It simply when one part of your Plato hydrometer reading feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
